subtopic: Limits of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
solution:
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{5^{x} - 1}{\sin x}\right]\)

Divide Numerator and Denominator by \(x\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{\dfrac{5^{x} - 1}{x}}{\dfrac{\sin x}{x}}\right]\)

\(= \dfrac{\lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{5^{x} - 1}{x}\right]}{\lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{\sin x}{x}\right]}\)

\(= \dfrac{\log 5}{1}\)

.... \(\left[\because \lim_{\theta \to 0}\left(\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\right) = 1,\ \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{a^{x} - 1}{x}\right) = \log a\right]\)

\(= (\log 5)\)

subtopic: Limits of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
solution:
[Textbook misprint in a citation: the standard result is quoted as \(\lim_{x \to a}\left(\frac{a^x - 1}{x}\right) = \log a\), where the limit must be \(x \to 0\). The same result is printed correctly with \(x \to 0\) both in the preceding example and in the section's own statement of it.]

Given \(\lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{5^{x} - 3^{x}}{x}\right]\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{5^{x} - 1 - 3^{x} + 1}{x}\right]\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{\left(5^{x} - 1\right) - \left(3^{x} - 1\right)}{x}\right]\)

\(= \log 5 - \log 3\) ..... \(\lim_{x \to a}\left(\dfrac{a^{x} - 1}{x}\right) = \log a\)

\(= \log\left(\dfrac{5}{3}\right)\)
_note: Book misprint in the printed solution's citation: the standard result is quoted as \(\lim_{x \to a}\left(\frac{a^x-1}{x}\right)=\log a\); the limit should be \(x \to 0\) (the same result is printed correctly with \(x \to 0\) in the SolvedEx.1 citation and in §7.6 result 2). Transcribed as printed.

solution:
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{e^{2x} + e^{-2x} - 2}{x \sin x}\right) = \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{e^{2x}\left(e^{2x} + e^{-2x} - 2\right)}{e^{2x}\, x \sin x}\right)\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{e^{4x} + 1 - 2e^{2x}}{e^{2x}\, x \sin x}\right)\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{\left(e^{2x}\right)^{2} - 2e^{2x} + 1}{e^{2x}\, x \sin x}\right)\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{\left(e^{2x} - 1\right)^{2}}{x \sin x} \times \dfrac{1}{e^{2x}}\right)\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{\dfrac{\left(e^{2x} - 1\right)^{2}}{x^{2}}}{\dfrac{x \sin x}{x^{2}}} \times \dfrac{1}{e^{2x}}\right)\)

.... [As \(x \to 0,\ x \ne 0,\ x^{2} \ne 0\)]

\(= \dfrac{\left[\lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{e^{2x} - 1}{2x}\right)\right]^{2} \times 4}{\lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{\sin x}{x}\right)} \times \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{1}{e^{2x}}\right)\)

\(= \dfrac{(1)^{2} \times 4}{1} \times \dfrac{1}{e^{0}}\) ..... \(\left[\because \lim_{x \to 0}\dfrac{e^{kx} - 1}{kx} = 1,\ \lim_{\theta \to 0}\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\theta} = 1\right]\)

\(= 4\)

subtopic: Limits of Exponential and Logarithmic Functions
solution:
\(\lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{21^{x} - 7^{x} - 3^{x} + 1}{x \log(1 + x)}\right)\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{7^{x} \cdot 3^{x} - 7^{x} - 3^{x} + 1}{x \log(1 + x)}\right)\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left(\dfrac{7^{x}\left(3^{x} - 1\right) - \left(3^{x} - 1\right)}{x \log(1 + x)}\right)\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{\left(3^{x} - 1\right)\left(7^{x} - 1\right)}{x \log(1 + x)}\right]\)

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{\dfrac{\left(3^{x} - 1\right)\left(7^{x} - 1\right)}{x^{2}}}{\dfrac{x \log(1 + x)}{x^{2}}}\right]\) ....[As \(x \to 0,\ x^{2} \ne 0\)]

\(= \lim_{x \to 0}\left[\dfrac{\dfrac{3^{x} - 1}{x} \times \dfrac{7^{x} - 1}{x}}{\dfrac{\log(1 + x)}{x}}\right]\)

\(= \dfrac{\log 3 \cdot \log 7}{1}\)

.... \(\left[\because \lim_{x \to 0}\dfrac{a^{x} - 1}{x} = \log a,\ \lim_{x \to 0}\dfrac{\log(1 + x)}{x} = 1\right]\)

\(= \log 3 \cdot \log 7\)
